name: Ancestry Trait
description: Selecting another Ancestry trait (if it makes sense) can make for a great Major Boon.

name: Aggressive
description: On your first round of combat you can spend 1 Action from your next turn.

name: Brave
description: +2 to damage while you have the most enemies adjacent to you.

name: Good Patient
description: Whenever you would receive healing, you heal an additional KEY HP .

name: Hardy
description: Whenever you would roll your Hit Dice to increase your max HP , roll with advantage 2 instead.

name: Honorable Protector
description: Gain LVL temp HP whenever you Interpose. Suffer LVL psychic damage whenever an ally within 2 spaces is attacked and you don't Interpose.

name: Lionhearted
description: +2 Armor while you have the most enemies adjacent to you.

name: Natural Talent
description: Learn 1 Cantrip in a school you don't know.

name: Resolute
description: When pushed, you are pushed 1 space less. Whenever you would be knocked Prone, you can instead be moved back 1 space. 1/turn.

name: Resilient
description: If you would take any Wounds, you may become immune to them this turn instead. 1/Safe Rest.

name: Smart, Not Book Smart
description: -KEY max mana. Gain 1d4 mana whenever you roll Initiative; this expires if unused at the end of combat.

name: Sniper
description: Advantage on attacks when no enemy is adjacent to you; disadvantage otherwise.

name: Tough
description: Whenever you gain temp HP , gain 5 more.

name: Unflinching
description: Your focus is unbroken even in the face of danger. Advantage on Concentration checks.

name: Epic Criticals
description: Whenever you roll for critical hit damage, you may replace one die with a d20.

name: Epic Foresight
description: Gain +5 to Initiative rolls and advantage on your first attack each encounter.

name: Epic Knowledge
description: 1/day, you can call upon a moment of profound insight to gain hidden knowledge about a legendary person or object.

name: Epic Mana
description: Whenever you are healed, you may instead recover 1 mana for every 5 HP you would have been healed.

name: Epic Stamina
description: Rolling 4 or higher on a Hit Die during a Field Rest heals 1 Wound.

name: Epic Resistance
description: 1/encounter. Whenever you would suffer damage or fail a save you can choose not to instead.
